scope: 50 multiple-choice cases from SLAKE (Liu et al., ISBI 2021; huggingface.co/datasets/BoKelvin/SLAKE), English test/validation questions with 4 options; distractors are drawn from SLAKE answer vocabularies, excluding answers SLAKE gives for the same image.
attribution: SLAKE: A Semantically-Labeled Knowledge-Enhanced Dataset for Medical Visual Question Answering
